item.description: Greater Hazleton Area and beyond Hazleton Art League’s Annual Member Show: Through Feb. 22. Hayden Family Center for the Arts, 31 W. Broad St., Hazleton. item.title: Flyers find a bumpy landing with loss in Boston
item.description: Problems with their flight from Columbus Wednesday night meant the Flyers didn’t get to bed in Boston until after 4 o'clock Thursday morning. They played like it in a 6-3 loss to the Bruins.

item.title: H.S. SWIMMING: Cougars, Valley West split WVC meet
item.description: Lia Ochs won her two individual events and was part of two winning relay teams to lead Hazleton Area to a 116-54 victory over visiting Wyoming Valley West in a Wyoming Valley Conference girls’ swim meet on Thursday. The sophomore standout took top honors in both the 50-yard freestyle and 100 backstroke and was with Mercede DeLorenzo, Lorelei Lucas and Mariannyi Brache Minaya on the first-place 200 medley relay and joined Lily Kash, Ashley Malaga and Kathleen Rodgers on the winning 400 freestyle
